import time, random
nb=33*256
MODBITS=2048
def mk(k):
    # k set bits scattered
    h=0
    for _ in range(k):
        h |= 1<<random.randrange(nb*8)
    return h
for k in (1,3,10):
    h=mk(k)
    # strategy A: bit trick
    t0=time.perf_counter(); N=2000
    for _ in range(N):
        hits=h
        out=[]
        while hits:
            lb = hits & -hits
            out.append(lb.bit_length()-1)
            hits ^= lb
    t1=time.perf_counter()
    print("k=%d bitrick us:"%k, (t1-t0)/N*1e6, len(out))
    # strategy B: to_bytes + enumerate scan limited by bit_length
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    for _ in range(N):
        b = h.to_bytes(nb,'little')
        out=[]
        for i,byte in enumerate(b):
            if byte:
                while byte:
                    lb=byte&-byte
                    out.append(i*8+lb.bit_length()-1)
                    byte^=lb
    t1=time.perf_counter()
    print("k=%d bytescan us:"%k, (t1-t0)/N*1e6, len(out))
EOF
